title: BD FACS Aria II Shutdown
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdvpi65n
materials: BD Falcon 5 ml polystyrene round bottom tubes
Safely shutdown and cleaned BD FACS Aria II
Warning: Personal Protective Equipment () should be used at all times while operating this protocol. If you are unsure what you should be using, see your immediate supervisor.
Exit BD FACSDiva software and shut down the computer.
Reset suction to 20% and begin stream again.

steps.title: Turn off cytometer power
steps.instruction: Press the large green power button on the left side of the Aria to turn off the main Cytometer power.

steps.title: Depressurize sheath tanks
steps.instruction: Depressurize the sheath tanks and refill them with sheath fluid.

steps.title: Empty waste and add bleach
steps.instruction: Empty waste into the sink; add bleach if the waste tank does not already contain bleach.

steps.title: Shut down aerosol system
steps.instruction: Turn off the Aerosol Management System and the Water Cooler if they were used.

steps.title: Clean flow cell
steps.instruction: Select Cytometer > Cleaning Modes > Clean Flow Cell; remove the nozzle, insert the integrated closed‑loop nozzle, clean the flow cell twice with MilliQ water; install a tube containing ~4 mL MilliQ H₂O and click Okay.

steps.title: Prepare fluidics shutdown
steps.instruction: Select Cytometer > Fluidics Shutdown; ensure the 70 % EtOH tank is filled to the weld line before proceeding.

steps.title: Remove and replace nozzle
steps.instruction: Remove the nozzle from the flow‑cell assembly and click Done; then insert the integrated closed‑loop nozzle and click Done.

steps.title: Disconnect and reconnect lines
steps.instruction: Disconnect the air line from the sheath tank and connect it to the air port on the ETON shutdown tank; disconnect the fluid line from the bottom of the sheath filter and connect it to the ethanol filter on the ethanol shutdown tank.

steps.title: Install MilliQ water tube
steps.instruction: When prompted, install a tube containing ~4 mL MilliQ H₂O on the loading port and click Done.

steps.title: Power off system
steps.instruction: Click Okay when the message appears that the system can be turned off.

steps.title: Run bleach cleaning
steps.instruction: Load and run a tube of 10 % bleach for at least 1 minute at a flow rate of 11.

steps.title: Run DI water rinse
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous step with a tube of de‑ionized (DI) water.

steps.title: Perform weekly shutdown steps
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 2 through 12 from the Weekly Shutdown Procedure.

steps.title: Monthly aseptic clean
steps.instruction: Run the ‘Prepare for Aseptic Sort’ cleaning module (Cytometer > Cleaning Modes > Prepare for Aseptic Sort); follow the wizard (≈1 hour) and consult BD FACSAria II User’s Guide pages 187‑190.

steps.title: Verify AMS power
steps.instruction: Ensure the main POWER button on the back of the evacuator is on, then press the POWER button on the evacuator’s membrane panel.

steps.title: Set suction control rate
steps.instruction: Set suction control rate to 20 % (do not exceed 20 %).

steps.title: Check filter flow gauge
steps.instruction: Verify that the filter flow gauge reads less than 2.4 inches.

steps.title: Clog remediation (if needed)
steps.instruction: If a clog occurs: (a) turn stream off while keeping top and flow‑chamber doors closed; (b) increase suction rate to 100 % and wait ≥1 minute to evacuate aerosols; (c) remove nozzle, place it in a clean FACS tube with MilliQ H₂O, cap, sonicate 1 minute, then remove and dry with kimwipes.

steps.title: Place AMS on standby
steps.instruction: After sorting is finished, press the POWER button on the evacuator membrane panel to put the Aerosol Management System on standby.
